summary: legal checked in 7 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for bounded public beta or full launch; conditional for continued private preview. Exact decision: retain searchwoot.com as keep_private and authorize no public beta, go-live, monetization expansion, advertising, or production launch change this cycle. Evidence: current launch-readiness records keep the site password-gated and noindex/nofollow; Woot documentation confirms API access and rate limits but not permission to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize the data. Accuracy/freshness, security/release, measurement/attribution, privacy, consent, vendor, retention, correction, takedown, and rollback evidence remain incomplete. Fleet compliance is technical triage only: 35 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown of 59 scanned sites; failures include missing cookie banner/accept/reject controls on 16 sites and missing privacy/terms evidence on 4 sites. Human counsel is required for unresolved source rights, privacy and consent scope, consumer and affiliate disclosures, copyright/trademark use, platform policy, and any regulated or age-sensitive determination. Incomplete telemetry does not by itself block ordinary growth, but it prevents launch or financial claims for this gated product.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active. Progress: 0 of 4 legal tasks are evidenced closed; all four remain open. Non-legal gates remain blocked for accuracy/freshness, measurement/attribution, and security/release. Close no task without evidence. Next evidence action: attach the current authoritative Woot API agreement or written permission, field-level provenance, permitted storage/caching/display/alert and monetization uses, attribution requirements, freshness limits, and correction/takedown process to searchwoot-legal-source-rights.

Data-use review dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data = evidence_needed; missing rights for storage, historical derivatives, public display, images, trademarks, prices, savings claims, alerts, affiliate links, and advertising, plus provenance and freshness/correction controls. Smallest next action: produce a rights-and-data inventory from authoritative terms or written permission. User alert rules and sync results = evidence_needed; missing field inventory, retention, deletion, access/correction, Slack/email processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only data-flow and retention table from the repository and deployed configuration. GA4 analytics = evidence_needed; missing deployed consent/withdrawal evidence, property and data-sharing settings, retention, vendor disclosure, and jurisdiction treatment. Smallest next action: capture consent and configuration evidence without enabling new tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data = evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms/DPA review, and incident/data-subject-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce the operator/vendor inventory and flag counsel-required gaps. No item is clear or approved for public beta.

Revenue and data-quality disposition: do not make site-level revenue, margin, ROI, CAC, payback, forecast, or experiment-impact claims. Available evidence supports portfolio activity of 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21 only; 629 clicks and all 28 ordered items are under tracking_id "other", so attribution is incomplete. Analytics is unavailable for all 60 registry sites. Continue ordinary low-risk work that is separately authorized and continue the existing Great American Lakes measurement window without duplicating work or declaring success before its recorded thresholds.

Private or gated-site checklist: searchwoot.com must remain password-gated and noindex/nofollow until the owner records keep-private or a later disposition after all applicable gates pass. The existing public inspection confirms a private-preview page; it does not evidence access-control robustness, alert-data protection, log handling, or incident readiness. Do not treat the draft site terms, privacy page, or cookie page as evidence of upstream data permission or counsel approval.

No go-live proposal is retained. Accordingly, no implementation.launch_gate or implementation.legal_review approval is issued. Any future go-live proposal must include implementation.launch_gate="go_live", implementation.legal_review.status="approved" or "needs_owner", reviewed_by="legal", and a concise evidence-supported decision_note; legal approval is not supportable on the current record.

Retain SearchWoot as private. Source rights, accuracy, privacy, security, attribution, and rollback gates remain unresolved; no public beta, monetization expansion, advertising, or production launch change is authorized.
